Hi Alex — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the context and the RFP. I’ve attached our standard hosted rate card and a short model-performance CSV that summarizes common latency bands. Summary answers below (quick reference):

- Baseline hosted API rates (per 1M tokens):
  • small-general (7B equiv): input $6.00 / 1M, output $10.00 / 1M
  • medium-general (13B equiv): input $12.00 / 1M, output $22.00 / 1M
  • large-general (34B equiv): input $28.00 / 1M, output $48.00 / 1M
  • instruction-tuned-chat variants: +20% over the corresponding general model rate (due to optimizer overhead on conversational context)
  • embeddings (per 1M tokens of text processed): $4.50 / 1M

- Typical hosted latency (p50/p95 rough bands, subject to tenant load and request shape):
  • small-general: 40ms / 220ms token gen
  • medium-general: 55ms / 340ms
  • large-general: 120ms / 900ms

- Streaming: billed on generated tokens (output) as usual; prefix/cache effects can reduce input billing if you reuse prompts.

- Committed/volume discounts: standard available at 6–15% depending on term and commit. For large strategic deals we can consider deeper discounts and fixed throughput SLA under Redwood Dedicated; I’ll confirm options below if you share target annual commit.

I attached: Redwood-Hosted-Ratecard-v1.pdf and model-performance-summary.csv. Happy to jump on a 30-min call Monday to walk through. Does 10am PT work?

Best,
Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference
